description: This file contains C source code implementing utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing input/output data, mainly used for testing purposes in a unit test context.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a buffer within a test_ut_memory_t structure, handling errors and setting the length accordingly.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file (if successfully read) and a given key-value pair string to standard output for debugging purposes.
